tool.name: CRISPRTarget visualize
tool.description: render the text and graphical reports of CRISPRTarget target predictions
tool.command: ln -s '$tabular_input' input.tab && CRISPRTargetGraphics.pl -in input.tab -txt '$txt_out' $include_url $include_pvalue && CRISPRTargetGraphics.pl -in input.tab -html '$html_out' $include_url $include_pvalue

param.name: tabular_input
param.label: CRISPRTarget target predictions in tabular format
param.help: This is the tabular output of the CRISPRTarget tool (one line per target, 34 columns), possibly filtered or modified.

param.name: include_url
param.label: Include links to the NCBI sequence viewer
param.help: Adds link texts to the graphical report. The links are only rendered if the URL_Link column is filled.

param.name: include_pvalue
param.label: Include the p-values in the reports
param.help: The p-values are only rendered if the P_value column is filled.

tool.help:
**What it does**
This tool renders the text and the html report of CRISPRTarget from a tabular file of target predictions, i.e. from the tabular output of the CRISPRTarget tool. This is useful if the predictions were filtered or modified in the history, e.g. to keep only the high scoring matches or the matches to a certain set of phages, and the alignments of the remaining matches should be inspected.
The input file is expected to be the tabular output of CRISPRTarget without a header line (34 columns, see the help of the CRISPRTarget tool for the column description). Lines of the file in which a column is missing or in the wrong order cannot be rendered.
-----
**Options**
- **Include links to the NCBI sequence viewer** - add the links to the NCBI sequence viewer of the matched database sequences (the ``URL_Link`` column). - **Include the p-values in the reports** - add the p-values of the matches (the ``P_value`` column).
